actions.description: Search the local instance for the issue whose link field holds the incoming remote issue key.
actions.name: Find Local Issue by Remote Issue Key

conditions.description: The incoming Jira webhook must contain an issue key
Loop guard: skip every event authored by the remote iHub integration user

actions.description: Create a local issue from an incoming remote jira:issue_created event.
actions.name: Create Local Issue

conditions.description: No local issue is linked to this remote issue yet
Loop guard: only create when the remote link field is empty, otherwise the remote issue is already a mirror
Loop guard: skip issues created by the remote iHub integration user

actions.description: Write the new local issue key into the remote link field so both sides are linked.
actions.name: Store Local Issue Key on Remote Issue

conditions.description: Only write back the local key after a remote create event

actions.description: Update the summary and description of the linked local issue.
actions.name: Update Local Issue

conditions.description: Loop guard: skip updates made by the remote iHub integration user, including the local key write back
Loop guard: skip updates whose changelog only contains the remote link field

actions.description: Check whether this remote comment has already been copied to the local issue.
actions.name: Get Remote Comment ID Property

conditions.description: The incoming comment payload must contain a comment id
Loop guard: skip comments written by the remote iHub integration user

actions.description: Add the remote comment to the linked local issue, passing the ADF body through unchanged.
actions.name: Add Remote Comment to Local Issue

conditions.description: Only add the comment when it has not been synced yet

actions.name: Store Incoming Remote Comment ID
actions.description: Store the remote comment id on the local issue to avoid duplicate webhook processing.

scriptedVariables.name: remoteAttachmentId
scriptedVariables.script:
const item = scope?.payload && typeof scope.payload === 'object' ? scope.payload : scope;
return item?.id != null ? String(item.id) : '';

scriptedVariables.name: remoteAttachmentFileName
scriptedVariables.script:
const item = scope?.payload && typeof scope.payload === 'object' ? scope.payload : scope;
return item?.filename || item?.fileName || 'remote-jira-file';

scriptedVariables.name: remoteAttachmentContentUrl
scriptedVariables.script:
const item = scope?.payload && typeof scope.payload === 'object' ? scope.payload : scope;
return item?.content || '';

scriptedVariables.name: remoteAttachmentAuthorAccountId
scriptedVariables.script:
const item = scope?.payload && typeof scope.payload === 'object' ? scope.payload : scope;
return item?.author?.accountId || '';

actions.description: Check whether this remote attachment has already been copied to the local issue. Jira has no attachment webhook event, so attachments are detected from a jira:issue_updated changelog entry for the Attachment field.
actions.name: Get Remote Attachment ID Property

conditions.description: The changelog must contain an Attachment field change
Loop guard: skip attachments added by the remote iHub integration user

actions.description: Download the remote attachment binary from the remote Jira instance.
actions.name: Download Remote Attachment

conditions.description: Only download when the attachment has not been synced yet
The attachment must expose a content URL

actions.description: Upload the downloaded remote attachment to the linked local issue.
actions.name: Add Remote Attachment to Local Issue
Store Incoming Remote Attachment ID
actions.description: Store the remote attachment id on the local issue to avoid duplicate uploads.

description: Sync remote Jira Cloud webhook events to local Jira issues

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key in the local instance (the instance where iHub is installed) that holds the synced issues

flowVariables.name: ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Issue type name used when creating issues in the local instance, for example Task or Bug

flowVariables.name: REMOTE_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Base URL of the remote Jira Cloud instance, for example https://acme.atlassian.net

flowVariables.name: REMOTE_PROJECT
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key in the remote instance that holds the synced issues

flowVariables.name: REMOTE_ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Issue type name used when creating issues in the remote instance. Issue type names differ per instance, so this is separate from ISSUE_TYPE

flowVariables.name: LOCAL_IHUB_ACCOUNT_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Atlassian accountId of the iHub integration user in the LOCAL instance. Loop prevention: events authored by this account are skipped. The same value is hard coded in the action conditions and must be replaced there too

flowVariables.name: REMOTE_IHUB_ACCOUNT_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Atlassian accountId of the iHub integration user in the REMOTE instance. This is a different account from LOCAL_IHUB_ACCOUNT_ID. The same value is hard coded in the action conditions and must be replaced there too

name: Jira Incoming Sync
